changes.to: Embedded AI processor 200+ TOPS plus an x86 industrial real-time control board

Maker spec slide linked from corenetic.ai/en/product (cdn.yuanluo.cloud/.../monte02_params.webp, read 2026-11-17): dimensions 590 x 619 x 1623 mm, 100 kg, high-strength magnesium-aluminium frame with ABS shell, 25 DoF with grippers (base 2 + waist 3 + head 2 + arms 7x2 + grippers 2x2; 39 with two 9-DoF dexterous hands), 702 mm arm length with 7-DoF SRS anthropomorphic arms, 6.5 kg max per arm at the end flange (payload_kg = per-arm figure), adaptive two-finger gripper or multi-finger hand with automatic quick swap, two-wheel differential drive at 1.0 m/s on indoor floors with slope <=10 deg, 51.2 V / 30 Ah battery (1536 Wh computed), 8 h typical runtime, 2 h fast charge, 200+ TOPS AI processor plus x86 real-time board, 1 head RGBD and 2x1 arm-end RGBD cameras, Wi-Fi 6 / gigabit Ethernet / full Type-C. Maker's slide notes the figures are lab measurements for reference only.
Corenetic's larger wheeled humanoid variant with a magnesium-aluminium frame, 6.5 kg per arm and quick-swap end effectors for lab and industrial work.
